'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 845
|text = The cryptic reveals where to dig:<br><br>Dig near some giant mushrooms, behind the Grand Tree.
|notes = Dig near the red mushrooms north-west of the [[Grand Tree]].
|map = {{Map|2458,3504|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Royal seed pod]], or [[grand seed pod]] squash option.
*[[Gnome glider]] to Ta Quir Priw.
*[[Balloon transport system]] to the [[Grand Tree]].
*[[Spirit tree]] to [[Gnome Stronghold]].
*[[Games necklace]] teleport to [[Barbarian Outpost]] then use the [[Agility shortcut]] with 37 [[Agility]].
*[[Slayer ring]] to the [[Stronghold Slayer Cave]].
*[[Necklace of passage]] to the [[Outpost]] and run north.
*[[Ardougne Teleport]] or [[West Ardougne Teleport]] and run north to [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]].
